item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The graph shows Esha's snack stall sales on Sports Day. The vertical scale uses equal intervals.

Which snack sold the most?

options.A: Juice, because its bar is tallest on the equal-interval scale.
options.B: Samosa, because the snack name alone settles the sales value.
options.C: Fruit, as if equal intervals on the vertical scale are not required.
options.D: Juice, because darker shading settles the sales value.
